from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_CEILING
from hashlib import sha256
from html import unescape
from pathlib import Path
import json, re

base = Path('products/services/sqlite-lemon-squeezy-seller-fit')
source = (base / 'raw/fees.html').read_bytes()
text = source.decode('utf-8')
text = re.sub(r'<(script|style)\b[^>]*>.*?</\1\s*>', ' ', text, flags=re.S | re.I)
text = ' '.join(unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', text)).split())
fee = re.search(r'(?:5\s*%\s*\+\s*\$\s*0\.50|\$\s*0\.50\s*\+\s*5\s*%)', text)
minimum = re.search(r'(?:minimum payout(?: threshold| amount)?[^.!?]{0,70}?\$\s*50\b|\$\s*50\b[^.!?]{0,55}?minimum payout)', text, re.I)

def excerpt(match):
    return text[max(0, match.start()-100):match.end()+100] if match else None

scenarios = []
if fee:
    for price in (Decimal('9.00'), Decimal('19.00')):
        for additional_rate in (Decimal('0'), Decimal('0.015'), Decimal('0.03')):
            charge = (price * (Decimal('0.05') + additional_rate) + Decimal('0.50')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_CEILING)
            net = price - charge
            scenarios.append({'hypothetical_price_usd': str(price), 'hypothetical_additional_rate': str(additional_rate), 'modeled_fee_usd': str(charge), 'modeled_proceeds_usd_before_payout_costs': str(net), 'sales_to_modeled_50_usd_balance': int((Decimal('50') / net).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING)) if minimum else None})

report = {'source_url': 'https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/help/getting-started/fees', 'source_sha256': sha256(source).hexdigest(), 'base_fee_excerpt': excerpt(fee), 'possible_payout_threshold_excerpt': excerpt(minimum), 'scenarios': scenarios, 'assumptions': ['One item per order, one-time payment, no tax in modeled fee base, no refunds or chargebacks.', 'Additional rates are sensitivity inputs only. Applicability to the intended seller or buyer remains unverified.', 'Fee rounded up to cents for illustration. Excludes payout and conversion costs. Any threshold calculation is a modeled balance, with exact currency and payout treatment subject to confirmation.', 'A missing match means this capture and extraction did not establish the term.'], 'decision_limit': 'Private pricing evidence only. Seller approval, package eligibility, checkout activation, sales, payouts and Treasury settlement require separate evidence.'}
out = base / 'director-pricing-sensitivity.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

description: The marketplace capture returned HTTP 200, so the next step is to turn the saved fee terms into a reproducible pricing comparison for the existing SQLite download. The comparison covers two hypothetical prices and leaves seller approval, product eligibility and payout timing open. Treasury reports CAD 0 available and zero verified revenue. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Seller activation requires an authorized operator, and any public release requires independent approval of the exact digest.
